desc:
🐺 Start as a tiny +1 human and EVOLVE into a giant werewolf!

🍖 EAT on training pads to gain Howl and level up
⚔️ FIGHT through stages full of enemies and bosses
🏆 COLLECT Wins and EVOLVE into new breeds
💥 Land COMBOS and FINISHERS to unleash HOWL SLAM!

🐾 5 BREEDS to unlock:
Grey Wolf ➜ Ember Wolf 🔥 ➜ Frost Wolf ❄️ ➜ Pumpkin Wolf 🎃 ➜ Storm Wolf ⚡ NEW!

🌙 Your Howl keeps growing while you're offline – come back to claim it!
🎁 Daily rewards, playtime rewards and free gifts
👥 Play with friends for a Howl boost!

👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite the game for updates and new breeds!

Can you reach STORM KING, the strongest form? ⚡
